new_features: INDIRECT now resolves supported A1/R1C1 references, local names, quoted sheet-qualified ranges, and refreshable dynamic dependencies.
OFFSET returns tracked rectangular local or cross-sheet ranges; ADDRESS supports four absolute/relative modes, A1/R1C1 and worksheet text.
CELL accepts omitted and cross-sheet references; ISFORMULA and FORMULATEXT can inspect references across worksheets.
SUBTOTAL and supported AGGREGATE options refresh on filter visibility changes and use a bounded hidden-row cache.
Scatter charts plot multiple Y series against numeric X values with independent axis settings and XLSX axis round-trip.
Pie/doughnut charts support first-slice angle, hole sizing, per-slice colors, and label positions with XLSX round-trip.
Supported custom chart axis number formats render in SVG and are preserved in XLSX.
DAYS360 and YEARFRAC distinguish U.S. (NASD) and European 30/360 bases and use Excel serial-day lengths for Actual/Actual calculations.

Shared date helpers, NETWORKDAYS, WORKDAY, NETWORKDAYS.INTL, and WORKDAY.INTL validate serials and holidays through Excel serial 2,958,465 while retaining serial 60; WORKDAY.INTL rejects an all-weekend mask.
